headline: BetterBags Next introduces currency tracking with a detachable screen tracker and animation settings, along with stability fixes for zone loading screens.

entries.title: Currency tracking and floating tracker in BetterBags Next
entries.details: Track currencies and stackable items along the bottom of the backpack footer. You can drag the strip out into a customizable on-screen tracker widget, Shift-drag entries to reorder or remove them, and manage tracked items in the new Currencies settings tab.

entries.title: Toggle visual effects on any BetterBags Next theme
entries.details: A new Animation tab under Appearance lets you independently toggle individual visual effects such as sparkles, title shimmer, clouds, ribbons, and moving ornaments across any theme.

entries.title: Bag errors during dungeon transitions and loading screens
entries.details: Fixed an error that could occur when entering dungeons or crossing loading screens while item data temporarily unloads. Bag updates are now paused through every zone transfer rather than only during initial login.
